text.en: Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.
Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.

Direct Hits apply 'Blighted' to the target, dealing twice as much tick damage as Blighted Pools at half the rate for 9.5 seconds. Killing Blighted enemies causes them to drop a Blighted Pool.

Targets can only take damage from a instance of Blighted at a time.

Enemies that are Blighted can take simultaneous damage from a Blighted Pool, and also take 25% increased damage from <yellow Malfeasance and Wish-Ender. />

Blighted targets are <bold STILL NOT CONSIDERED TO BE TAKEN. />
